measurement: P0/P1 engineering repairs and the 100-contract retest

5A_spreadsheet_differential_review.defect: the reviewer read only sheetnames[0], so a correctly consolidated deliverable was reported as inventing values
5A_spreadsheet_differential_review.fix: _authorised_sheets() reads the scope the checklist declares via consolidate_sheets; _supplied_values() unions those sheets, each read with its own header
guards_kept: a value in NO authorised sheet still fails
a value from a sheet the checklist never named still fails
where no requirement widens the scope, the old first-sheet behaviour is unchanged

1_completed_jobs_held_capacity.defect: _committed_count counted every non-terminal job, and JobState.is_terminal covers only REJECTED and FAILED, so a finished job held its slot for ever
1_completed_jobs_held_capacity.fix: OCCUPIES_CAPACITY states the occupancy set explicitly rather than overloading is_terminal, which other code depends on
1_completed_jobs_held_capacity.design_decision: AWAITING_PAYMENT does NOT occupy a processing slot. The work has shipped; what is outstanding is money, and the unpaid-exposure limit governs that by amount. Holding a slot would re-seize the shop after 20 unpaid invoices. The debt, invoice and audit trail are untouched.

3_per_skill_commitment_pools.blocker: a job does not record which capability it belongs to. The jobs table has no such column, and job_class -- the only candidate -- is already the Governor's pricing-calibration key, so reusing it would silently change pricing.
3_per_skill_commitment_pools.needed: a new jobs column for the capability, set at intake from the opportunity's declared need, plus migration
3_per_skill_commitment_pools.why_not_done: a schema change touching both the capacity controller and the pricing calibration key space needs owner sign-off; shipping the pool logic without the data would have been a control that silently never binds
3_per_skill_commitment_pools.evidence: implemented, tested against the data, found inert, and backed out rather than shipped

5B_csv_independent_reader.blocker: worker and checker both use stdlib csv, so it cannot be the independent reader. No third-party CSV reader is installed (pandas, polars, pyarrow, csvkit, clevercsv all absent).
5B_csv_independent_reader.needed: a new third-party dependency, against the repository's zero-third-party-dependency principle
5B_csv_independent_reader.why_not_done: explicit owner authorisation required; fail-closed behaviour preserved and CSV T2 remains blocked
5B_csv_independent_reader.cost: 34 of 100 contracts still stop at verification-eligibility for this reason

5C_owner_signing_vs_delivery.blocker: harness.py mints an unsigned approval for the C2 delivery effect; with an Owner Channel configured the gate requires a signed one, so 0 of 100 contracts delivered with a key set
5C_owner_signing_vs_delivery.why_not_done: not attempted this round; it changes Action Gate authorisation flow and wants its own focused change and test pass

2_startup_reconciliation.evidence: 1-2 jobs per mid-cycle crash remain stranded in VERIFYING

4_brain_multi_candidate_ranking.note: run_business_cycle still ranks a list of one

attribution.method: the two arrangements isolate the two repairs: the fresh-system arm has no capacity pressure, so its gain is the 5A fix alone; the long-lived arm carries both.
attribution.5A_alone_fresh_arm: 43 -> 53 delivered (+10), the five-per-band independent-review rejections in the large and premium bands
attribution.caveat: an implied figure from two arms, not a separately ablated run

financial_effect.note: every figure simulated; Ledger.real_revenue_cents() reads 0 in both arms

first_time_observed: large ($1,200) and premium ($3,500) contracts delivered for the first time in this engagement: 5 of 25 in each band, after the 5A repair unblocked T2 spreadsheet review.
limits: Linux only; MT5 coexistence remains uncertified.
All customers, contracts, invoices and payments are synthetic.
Four of the six problem areas remain open, named above with their blockers.

regression.delta: exactly the 6 new tests in test_remediation_p0p1.py
regression.first_run_failure: QualificationOwnsNoEconomics tripped on the word 'calibration' in a docstring I added. The test is correct; the comment was reworded, not the test.

mutation.note: unchanged from the pre-repair run; neither repair loosened a pinned control
